sn35.233:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca ānando āyasmā ca kāmabhū kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghositārāme.
sn35.233:1.2: atha kho āyasmā kāmabhū sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn35.233:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā kāmabhū āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.233:2.1: kinnu kho āvuso ānanda, cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ, rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.233:2.2: jivhā rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ, rasā jivhāya saññojanaṃ, …pe…
sn35.233:3.1: na kho āvuso kāmabhū, cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.233:3.2: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.233:3.3: na jivhā rasānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rasā jivhāya saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.233:3.4: na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.233:3.5: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.233:4.1: seyyathāpi āvuso kāḷo ca balivaddo odāto ca balivaddo ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā assu.
sn35.233:4.3: kāḷo balivaddo odātassa balivaddassa saññojanaṃ, odāto balivaddo kāḷassa balivaddassa saññojananti sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyāti.
sn35.233:4.5: na kho āvuso kāḷo balivaddo odātassa balivaddassa saññojanaṃ, napi odāto balivaddo kāḷassa balivaddassa saññojanaṃ.
sn35.233:4.6: yena ca kho te ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saññuttā taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.233:4.7: evameva kho āvuso na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ, yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.233:4.9: na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ, taṃ dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ,
sn35.233:4.10: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojananti.
